entries.quote: Fixed agents, skills, and commands whose `.md` file starts with a UTF-8 BOM being silently ignored
Added `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`/`1`/`0` (case-insensitive) as accepted values for skill and plugin frontmatter booleans, alongside `true`/`false`
Plugin option values (`pluginConfigs`) are no longer read from project-level `.claude/settings.json`; only user, `--settings`, and managed settings are honored
Plugins can now declare `defaultEnabled: false` in `plugin.json` or a marketplace entry; enable them with `/plugin` or `claude plugin enable`
Hooks: `PostToolUse` and `PostToolUseFailure` hook inputs now include `duration_ms` (tool execution time, excluding permission prompts and PreToolUse hooks)
`/config` settings (theme, editor mode, verbose, etc.) now persist to `~/.claude/settings.json` and participate in project/local/policy override precedence

doc_pins.quote: Before v2.1.214, Claude Code treated that combination as a non-blocking error and the action proceeded.
Requires Claude Code v2.1.196 or later
Before v2.1.218, Claude Code recognized only `true` and `false`.
Before v2.1.239, Claude Code loaded the synced copy instead of a same-named marketplace install.
The `/mcp` command allows disabling MCP servers, but the disabled state is stored per-project (under `projects[path].disabledMcpServers` in `~/.claude.json`).
